name: Judas Priest

whyMatters.en: Birmingham metal band formed in 1969. Halford’s leather-and-studs image and Tipton/Downing twin-guitar attack define a classic metal look and sound; British Steel (1980) and Painkiller (1990) bookend the peak years.
whyMatters.zh: 伯明翰金属乐队，1969 年成立。Halford 的皮衣铆钉形象与 Tipton/Downing 双吉他攻击，定义经典金属外观与声音；British Steel（1980）与 Painkiller（1990）框住峰值年份。

note.en: British Steel short-riff single; twin-guitar hooks.
note.zh: British Steel 短 riff 单曲；双吉他钩子。

note.en: Travis double-bass and Halford highs; speed-metal peak track.
note.zh: Travis 双底鼓与 Halford 高音；速度金属峰值曲。

note.en: US radio metal hit; Screaming for Vengeance era.
note.zh: 美国电台金属热单；Screaming for Vengeance 时期。

interviewQuotes.text: Leather and studs became the uniform because it looked like the music sounded.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Rob Halford

interviewQuotes.text: Twin leads are the grammar. Everything else is dialect.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Glenn Tipton

lyricQuotes: There I was completely wasting, out of work and down
Faster than a bullet / Terrifying scream

shortBio.en: Halford plus twin-guitar metal; British Steel to Painkiller classic peak.
shortBio.zh: Halford 加双吉他金属；British Steel 至 Painkiller 经典峰值。

body.en:
Formed in 1969. Halford with Tipton/Downing twin leads define the leather-metal image. British Steel shortens songs for radio; Painkiller (1990) with Scott Travis raises tempo and double-bass density.

The classic peak runs from the Halford leather years through Painkiller.
body.zh:
1969 年组建。Halford 与 Tipton/Downing 双主音定义皮衣金属形象。British Steel 为电台缩短歌曲；与 Scott Travis 的 Painkiller（1990）提高速度与双底鼓密度。

经典峰值从 Halford 皮衣期延续到 Painkiller。

title.en: Twin guitar and leather metal look
title.zh: 双吉他与皮衣金属外观

body.en:
Priest establish harmony leads, studs image, and motorcycle stage entry as a portable metal package. Birmingham neighbors Black Sabbath; Priest choose speed and polish over doom crawl.

Maiden and US metal both read this twin-guitar and image approach.
body.zh:
Priest 把和声主音、铆钉形象与摩托车上场做成可移植的金属组合。伯明翰邻居是 Black Sabbath；Priest 选速度与抛光，而非 doom 爬行。

Maiden 与美国金属都读这套双吉他与形象做法。

body.en:
Peak: Halford / Tipton / Downing / Hill, later with Travis. The Ripper Owens 1990s chapter sits between Halford eras. Halford returns in 2003.

Chronicle peak = leather Halford twin-guitar years through Painkiller.
body.zh:
巅峰：Halford / Tipton / Downing / Hill，后期加 Travis。90 年代 Ripper Owens 章节夹在 Halford 两期之间。Halford 2003 回归。

编年史巅峰 = 皮衣 Halford 双吉他期至 Painkiller。

title.en: Operatic highs, dual leads, steady bass
title.zh: 歌剧高音、双主音、稳定贝斯

body.en:
Halford: wide vibrato and scream highs. Tipton/Downing: traded solos and harmony thirds. Hill: steady eighths. Travis: double-bass upgrade from 1989.

Image and arrangement travel together.
body.zh:
Halford：宽颤音与尖叫高音。Tipton/Downing：交替独奏与三度和声。Hill：稳定八分。Travis：1989 起双底鼓升级。

形象与编曲一起传播。

title.zh: Breaking the Law：短 riff 电台

body.en:
British Steel. Two-minute crime riff, gang vocal hook. Metal without epic runtime.

Entry for listeners before Painkiller speed.
body.zh:
British Steel。两分钟犯罪 riff、合唱钩子。无史诗时长的金属。

Painkiller 速度前的听众入口。

body.en:
Travis intro, Halford top notes, dense twin-guitar leads. 1990 statement after 80s polish.

Late classic peak track.
body.zh:
Travis 前奏、Halford 顶音、密集双吉他主音。80 年代抛光后的 1990 声明。

晚期经典峰值曲。

title.zh: 金属外观与双主音写作

body.en:
Leather look and twin-lead writing feed Maiden, Megadeth, and arena metal. Birmingham metal map: Sabbath doom, Priest speed and image.

Halford’s voice remains the main citation.
body.zh:
皮衣外观与双主音写作影响 Maiden、Megadeth 与体育场金属。伯明翰金属地图：Sabbath doom，Priest 速度与形象。

Halford 人声仍是主要引用。

note.en: British Steel through Painkiller peak window (Travis from 1989).
note.zh: British Steel 至 Painkiller 巅峰窗（Travis 自 1989）。
夹在 Halford 两期之间的 Jugulator / Demolition。

note.en: Short-riff metal single that fixed Priest’s radio face.
note.zh: 固定 Priest 电台脸的短 riff 金属单曲。

note.en: Leather look plus twin guitar as a portable metal package.
note.zh: 皮衣外观加双吉他，构成可移植的金属组合。
